gate_reconciliation.adoption_scope: Only confirmations prospectively registered under this sealed reconciliation; no retrospective change to the strict-code outcome.

policy.candidate_requirement: Frozen selected candidate must be ready, COMPLETE, finite, and in [0,1].
policy.change: Remove only the numeric reference-floor veto; retain absolute candidate thresholds, reference gap, and all-six-cells requirement.
policy.disclosure: Prospective code/text reconciliation after seed0 results; original executable outcomes remain reported separately. Fresh confirmation does not retroactively pass the original executable rule.
policy.name: beyond-stage1-written-rule-reconciliation-v1
policy.reference_requirement: Frozen selected reference must be ready, COMPLETE, finite, and in [0,1]; pending/missing/invalid references never pass.
policy.scope: Uniformly all A/B/C candidates and all six registered primary cells.

decision_rules.position_accuracy: Predict1 iff estimated p_t >0.5; ties predict0.
decision_rules.position_balanced_accuracy: Predict1 iff estimated p_t > estimated global prevalence pi; ties predict0.

match3_position_baseline.scope_limit: This is a calibrated empirical baseline, not an analytic Bayes upper bound and not an architectural pass threshold.

notes: Gate decisions are copied from sealed artifacts. No pass is inferred from rounded or raw report scores.
Validation and test are separate rows/files; only frozen validation-selected IDs choose screen plot points.
Word gate metric is balanced second-half accuracy; all-position accuracy and its SE are separate.
No standard error is invented for balanced late word accuracy or model Match3 balanced accuracy.
Regression error bars, when present, are 1.96 times the reported independent-example MSE standard error.
Position-only Match3 reference is an empirical explanatory control, not an architectural gate or upper bound.
Seed0 held-out plots describe the screen; independent confirmation plots are separately labeled.
